name: globepilot-ai-agent-2
examples_zh: 我持中国护照下个月去土耳其旅游，需要什么签证材料和入境注意事项？

帮我查巴黎戴高乐机场今天的运行状态，并推荐本周末当地活动和文化礼仪。
examples_en: I hold a US passport and plan to visit Vietnam next month; what visa rules and entry tips apply?

description_en: AI travel assistant for visa info, currency conversion, airport status and cultural tips
